summary_en: FY8/12 dividend per share raised to ¥97.50 end (from ¥86.50), full-year ¥476.50 (stock-split adjusted). Interim dividend ¥390.00 announced. Increase driven by expected ¥4,300M special gain from investment securities sale and stock split effective FY8/12.
title_en: Notice of Expected Special Gain from Sale of Investment Securities, Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast, and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY8/12
translation_en_brief:
Toukei Computer announced on 3 August 2026 that its board has approved partial sale of its investment securities portfolio, expected to realise a special gain of ¥4,300M in the FY8/12 (year ending 31 December 2026) consolidated results. The sale is intended to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns. Securities are to be sold between August and December 2026.

In light of this special gain and a stock split (separately disclosed), the company has revised its FY8/12 dividend forecast. The period-end dividend is increased from ¥86.50 to ¥97.50 per share (¥390.00 on a stock-split-adjusted interim basis). Full-year dividend is now forecast at ¥476.50 per share, comprising interim dividend of ¥390.00 and period-end dividend of ¥97.50 (pre-split figures). The company expects net profit attributable to parent shareholders to reach ¥8,601M (previously ¥5,501M), reflecting the investment securities gain. Net profit guidance was raised by ¥3,099M (56.3% increase). The revision aligns with the company's stated policy of stable dividend continuity linked to earnings performance.
